_comment: Hand-curated enrichment over dsl_catalog.json. Refines the ~35 highest-value Mission-Logic blocks with friendly labels/help and correct param types/widgets, and COMPLETES enum domains that usage-mining left partial. Param type vocabulary: bool,int,float,text,loc,enum(+enum_domain),unit_type,tag(+tag_kind=pos|zone|unit),camp_ref,ref(+ref_kind=var|group|timer),block_ref(+block_kind=condition|action|operator|constraint),list_of(+elem). replace_params=true means the auto param list was the wrong base-class one and is rebuilt here.

ConditionAnd.label: AND (all true)
ConditionAnd.help: True when every sub-condition is true.

ConditionDetectUnitDansZoneDetection.label: Units in zone?
ConditionDetectUnitDansZoneDetection.help: True when units (matching Contrainte) are in a detection zone.

ConditionNone.label: NONE (all false)
ConditionNone.help: True when no sub-condition is true.

ConditionOr.label: OR (any true)
ConditionOr.help: True when any sub-condition is true.

ConditionTimer.label: Timer reached a value?
ConditionTimer.help: Compare a timer against a value with an operator. The timer counts DOWN from its duration, so 'less or equal 0' is the usual 'time is up' test.

Operator.help: How to compare it, e.g. less or equal 0.

ConditionUnitGroup.label: How many units in a group?
ConditionUnitGroup.help: Compare the NUMBER of units in a group against a value. 'Less or equal 0' is the usual way to ask whether a group has been wiped out.

ConditionUnitGroupWithFilter.label: How many units in a group, filtered?
ConditionUnitGroupWithFilter.help: Like the unit group count, but only counts units that pass a filter - for example only the tanks, or only the ones inside a zone.

ConditionVariableInteger.label: Integer variable test
ConditionVariableInteger.help: Compare an integer variable against a value via an operator.

ContrainteOnUnitCategory.label: Only units of these kinds
ContrainteOnUnitCategory.help: A filter, not an action. Ticking boxes narrows which units a group or condition counts - infantry, tanks, aircraft, trucks, buildings, and states like in combat or hidden in woods.

ContrainteOnUnitTeam.label: Only units on a side
ContrainteOnUnitTeam.help: A filter that keeps units by side: the same side as the camp you pick, its allies, or its enemies.

ContrainteOnUnitType.label: Only this one unit type
ContrainteOnUnitType.help: A filter that keeps just one exact unit type. Invert result turns it around, keeping everything EXCEPT that type.

DescriptorActionToggleAutoSettingLoading.label: Action Toggle Auto Setting Loading Screen

DescriptorActiveCarte.label: Play a ruse card
DescriptorActiveCarte.help: Use one of the ruse cards for a camp, at a position on the map - the same cards a player plays.

DescriptorAddAllCampUnitsToUnitGroup.label: Add camp's units to group
DescriptorAddAllCampUnitsToUnitGroup.help: Populate a unit group with all of a camp's units (for objectives/conditions).

IncludeFake.help: Include decoy units. Must be given; normally False.

DescriptorAddCampAeroportToUnitGroup.label: Add Camp Aeroport To Unit Group

DescriptorAddCampCaserneToUnitGroup.label: Add Camp Caserne To Unit Group

DescriptorAddCampHqToUnitGroup.label: Add Camp Hq To Unit Group

DescriptorAddCampUsineCanonToUnitGroup.label: Add Camp Usine Canon To Unit Group

DescriptorAddCampUsineVehiculeToUnitGrou.label: Add Camp Usine Vehicule To Unit Group

DescriptorAddDetectedUnitsToUnitGroup.label: Collect what a detector sees
DescriptorAddDetectedUnitsToUnitGroup.help: Put every unit currently spotted by a detector into a group.

DescriptorAddUnitGroupListToUnitGroup.label: Copy several groups into one
DescriptorAddUnitGroupListToUnitGroup.help: Add the units from a list of groups into a single group. Give it a filter to copy only the units that pass.

DescriptorAddUnitGroupToUnitGroup.label: Copy a group into another
DescriptorAddUnitGroupToUnitGroup.help: Add every unit from one group into another. Give it a filter to copy only the units that pass.

DescriptorAttack.label: Order: attack
DescriptorAttack.help: Order a group to attack targets.

Targets.help: The group to attack. One group, not a list.

DescriptorBloqueCarteBluff.label: Block a RUSE card
DescriptorBloqueCarteBluff.help: Prevent a camp from using a RUSE/bluff card.

DescriptorBloqueTechno.label: Lock units (techno)
DescriptorBloqueTechno.help: Block a camp from building certain unit types.

DescriptorBloqueZoneForRuseAndOrder.label: Block zone For Ruse And Order

DescriptorChangeCamp.label: Hand units to another side
DescriptorChangeCamp.help: Move every unit in a group to a different camp. They stop being selectable by whoever held them, so this is how a defection or a capture is done.

DescriptorClearUnitGroup.label: Empty a group
DescriptorClearUnitGroup.help: Remove every unit from a group. The units are not harmed - only the group is emptied.

DescriptorCompetition.label: Race (first to finish wins)
DescriptorCompetition.help: Run SubActions in parallel; the first to complete stops the rest.

DescriptorCreateUnit.label: Spawn units
DescriptorCreateUnit.help: Put new units on the map at a map point, for a camp. Add them to a group if you want to give them orders or count them later. Decoy units look real to the enemy but cannot fight.

Group.help: Add the spawned units to this group (optional).

DescriptorDebloqueTechno.label: Unlock units (techno)
DescriptorDebloqueTechno.help: Allow a camp to build certain unit types.

DescriptorDeclencheDefaite.label: LOSE the mission
DescriptorDeclencheDefaite.help: Instantly lose. Put inside a fail action or an event.

DescriptorDeclencheVictoireChallenge.label: WIN the operation
DescriptorDeclencheVictoireChallenge.help: Instantly win (operations/challenges). Put inside an objective's ActionsReussi or an event.

DescriptorDeclencheVictoireChallengeForG.label: Trigger victory Challenge For Games Com

DescriptorDefendZone.label: Order: defend zone
DescriptorDefendZone.help: Order a group to defend a zone.

DescriptorDrawLabel.label: Draw map label
DescriptorDrawLabel.help: Show a text label on the map.

DescriptorFrappeArtillerie.label: Artillery strike
DescriptorFrappeArtillerie.help: Call an artillery strike on a position.

DescriptorGereObjectifAvecLabel.label: Objective (with label + bonus points)
DescriptorGereObjectifAvecLabel.help: A tracked objective shown on the HUD. Set BonusScoreMission for a secondary/bonus objective that grants extra points. Put a victory/defeat block in ActionsReussi to make it win/lose the mission.

Label.help: Objective text shown to the player.

ActionsReussi.help: Run on success (e.g. Win, give points).

DescriptorIAAll.label: Enable full AI for camp
DescriptorIAAll.help: Hand the camp to the full strategic AI (it builds/attacks on its own).

DescriptorIAObjectifAttaques.label: AI: attack zones
DescriptorIAObjectifAttaques.help: Tell the AI camp to attack a list of zones (waves).

DescriptorIAObjectifDefense.label: AI: defend zones
DescriptorIAObjectifDefense.help: Tell the AI camp to defend a list of zones.

DescriptorIARemoveAllObjectives.label: Clear AI objectives
DescriptorIARemoveAllObjectives.help: Remove all scripted AI objectives from a camp.

DescriptorKillAllUnit.label: Destroy a whole group
DescriptorKillAllUnit.help: Kill every unit in a group at once. The cause of death decides how they die on screen.

DescriptorLaunchVideoFXByName.label: Launch Video F X By Name

DescriptorModifieDegatsInfliges.label: Change how much damage units deal
DescriptorModifieDegatsInfliges.help: Multiply the damage a group deals. Below 1 weakens them, above 1 makes them hit harder.

DescriptorModifieStressRecu.label: Change how much stress units take
DescriptorModifieStressRecu.help: Multiply the stress a group suffers. Below 1 makes them steadier under fire, above 1 makes them panic sooner.

DescriptorModifieVitesseUnit.label: Change how fast units move
DescriptorModifieVitesseUnit.help: Multiply a group's movement speed. Below 1 slows them down, above 1 speeds them up.

DescriptorMove.label: Order: move
DescriptorMove.help: Move a unit group along positions.

DescriptorParachutage.label: Airdrop (paradrop)
DescriptorParachutage.help: Parachute a unit group to a position.

DescriptorPlayDialogSimplifie.label: Say a line
DescriptorPlayDialogSimplifie.help: Play one line of dialogue. This is the short way to do it - the game expands it into a full cutscene dialogue behind the scenes.

DescriptorPrint.label: Print a debug message
DescriptorPrint.help: Write a message to the game's log. For testing only - players never see it.

DescriptorProduitUnits.label: Queue production
DescriptorProduitUnits.help: Make a camp produce units through its buildings.

DescriptorRemoveUnitFromUnitGroup.label: Take a unit out of a group
DescriptorRemoveUnitFromUnitGroup.help: Remove one unit from a group. The unit is not harmed.

DescriptorSequential.label: Sequence (do in order)
DescriptorSequential.help: Run SubActions one after another. Repeat=True loops forever (use for periodic events).

DescriptorSetRessourceCamp.label: Set camp money
DescriptorSetRessourceCamp.help: Set a camp's resources to an exact amount.

DescriptorSetVariableInteger.label: Set a number
DescriptorSetVariableInteger.help: Put a specific value into a number variable. Use it to remember something happened, or to feed a number the objective text shows.

DescriptorSetVariableIntegerFromUnitGrou.label: Set Variable Integer From Unit Group

DescriptorStartTimer.label: Start timer
DescriptorStartTimer.help: Reset a timer to its full duration and start it counting down. To resume without resetting, use Resume timer.

DescriptorUnitGroupPorteeDeTirLimitee.label: Unit Group Portee De Tir Limitee

DescriptorWaitCondition.label: Wait until condition
DescriptorWaitCondition.help: Block until the condition becomes true.

DescriptorWaitDuree.label: Wait N seconds
DescriptorWaitDuree.help: Pause for a number of seconds.

DescriptorWaitForEver.label: Wait forever
DescriptorWaitForEver.help: Never finishes. Used to park a branch so the things running beside it keep going.

ModifieParametresIA.label: Tune AI behaviour
ModifieParametresIA.help: Adjust an AI camp's aggressiveness and unit-type bonuses.

OperatorIntegerEqual.label: == value
OperatorIntegerEqual.help: True when the variable equals Value.

OperatorIntegerLessOrEqual.label: <= value
OperatorIntegerLessOrEqual.help: True when the variable is <= Value.

OperatorIntegerMoreOrEqual.label: >= value
OperatorIntegerMoreOrEqual.help: True when the variable is >= Value.

TagPosition.label: Map point
TagPosition.help: A named point on the map. The name must match a placement's Name in the Map Editor - that is the only thing tying the script to the map. Used for spawn points, move targets and label positions.

TagUnit.label: Map unit
TagUnit.help: A named unit already placed on the map. The name must match that placement's Name in the Map Editor. Use it to give orders to a unit the mission starts with, rather than one it spawns.

TagZoneDetection.label: Map zone
TagZoneDetection.help: A named zone on the map, either a circle or a rectangle. The name must match a zone placement's Name in the Map Editor. Conditions use it to ask whether units are inside it.

VariableUnitGroup.label: Unit group
VariableUnitGroup.help: A named set of units (filled by Add...ToUnitGroup actions).

UnitList.help: Units the group starts with. Usually empty - actions add to it later - but it must still be given.
